descriptions.preferred: Valued for the beauty of its scarlet fall color, this old cultivar is described by one Japanese reference thus: "The sun shines on all the leaves and makes the fall foliage more 'Tennyo-no-hoshi' beautiful. " Spring leaves are a very light yellow- Palmatum green soon changing to light green. The tion medium-sized leaves have seven lobes separated gated over halfway to the flat base. They are long-eldeeply liptic, with sharp tips and slightly toothed marand gins. 'Tatsuta' grows to a medium-sized shrub of with up to 13 ft. (4 m) tall. It has open branches and a mostly rounded top. It is named after a place in Japan. lobe. Group—variegated. The chief attracof this cultivar is the unusual, lightly variefoliage. The small leaves have very narrow, separated lobes. The margins are wavy finely toothed. Base color is strong green a cream or light creamy green variegation, confined to a fine edging around each With the occasional stronger color break, the lobes develop a curve or twist. From a distance, the foliage has the appearance of a delicate cloud. Fall colors are a pleasant mixture of pale reds and rose. This cultivar is a strong grower and does well in full sun where the variegation has pink tones. It forms a medium-sized shrub of upright habit, eventually reaching about 13-16 ft. (4-5 m) high. The name means "angel's star. "

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一古老品种因其美丽的猩红秋色而备受珍视。 一份日本资料这样描述它：“阳光照在所有叶片上，使秋叶显得更加美丽。 ”春季新叶初展时为非常浅的黄绿色，随后很快转为浅绿色。 中等大小的叶片有 7 个裂片，裂至平截叶基的一半以上。 裂片狭长椭圆形，先端锐尖，边缘略具锯齿。 'Tatsuta' 可长成中等大小灌木，高可达 13 英尺（4 米），枝条较开张，树冠多呈圆形。 其名称来自日本一地名。 'Tennyo-no-hoshi' 属于斑叶类。 该品种的主要观赏点在于其不同寻常的浅斑叶色。 小型叶片裂片狭窄且彼此分离，叶缘呈波状并具细锯齿。 底色为浓绿色，带奶油色或浅奶油绿色斑纹，主要局限于每个裂片边缘的细窄镶边处。 偶尔斑色较强时，裂片会出现弯曲或扭转。 远观时，整株叶丛呈现出轻盈如云雾般的效果。 秋色是浅红与玫瑰色的柔和混合。 该品种生长势强，在全日照下表现良好，斑色中会带粉色调。 其形成直立型中等大小灌木，最终高约 13-16 英尺（4-5 米）。 其名称意为“天女之星”。
